Claims Agents

In some chapter 11 cases, a third-party claims agent may be employed by the debtor to handle certain administrative functions normally handled by the Clerk's Office. This includes maintenance of the claims in the case and notice of certain filings designated in the order appointing the agent. Claims agents have been employed in the open cases listed below.

Case No. Debtor Claims Agent Date Filed
26-11937 Magellan Aerospace, Middletown, Inc. Stretto July 22, 2026
25-52140 AmplifyBio, LLC Epiq May 16, 2025
22-50804 Volunteer Energy Services Inc. Epiq March 25, 2022
20-12043 Hopedale Mining LLC Epiq July 22, 2020
19-56885 Murray Energy Holdings Co. Kroll Restructuring Administration LLC October 29, 2019
